trust_decision.summary: Decided in the pinned tree at ChunkedDecoder::handleData: the chunked decoder must always make progress, i.e. either consume buffered bytes, return to wait for more data, or emit an error — the published fix adds a wait when the end chunk's trailer has no CRLF yet and closes the off-by-one hole where exactly two non-CRLF bytes after a completed chunk left the while-loop spinning forever.

landing_point.why: The advisory names a malformed 'Transfer-Encoding: chunked' body that pegs the CPU; the only chunked-body parser in the repository is the `while ($this->buffer !== '')` loop in ChunkedDecoder::handleData, and it is the one place where a buffer can be non-empty without any byte being consumed.

fix_sites.entry_point: React\Http\HttpServer / React\Http\Server incoming request body (RequestHeaderParser::handle creates ChunkedDecoder for any request with Transfer-Encoding, src/Io/RequestHeaderParser.php:100) and React\Http\Browser / Client incoming chunked response body (ClientRequestStream, src/Io/ClientRequestStream.php:214)
fix_sites.module_kind: internal stream decoder in the Io layer, shared by the server request-body path and the client response-body path

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site and no O8 route exist: both public entry points (server request body, client response body) instantiate the same ChunkedDecoder class, so the single published hunk covers both; the only dismissing argument left is that the class is marked @internal, which does not exclude the client path.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Chunk headers, chunk payload and end-chunk trailers legitimately arrive split across several 'data' events (TCP fragmentation), so a buffer with no CRLF while a chunk is incomplete or the trailer is unfinished must be buffered and awaited, not treated as malformed; an over-broad 'no CRLF found => error' guard breaks every split-chunk test, and a guard that errors on an unfinished trailer breaks the end-chunk trailer case.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: tests/Io/ChunkedDecoderTest.php:100 (testSplittedChunk), tests/Io/ChunkedDecoderTest.php:271 (testLateCrlf, CRLF delivered one byte at a time), tests/Io/ChunkedDecoderTest.php:365 (testEmitSingleCharacter), tests/Io/ChunkedDecoderTest.php:483 (testEndChunkWithTrailersWillBeIgnored)

O6_input_shapes: zero-size end chunk followed by trailer bytes with no terminating CRLF in the same data event, e.g. "0\r\nab" — must wait for more data, not loop and not error (fix.diff:13-16)

completed data chunk followed by exactly two bytes that are not a CRLF, e.g. "2\r\nabXY" — must raise 'Chunk does not end with a CRLF'; the pre-fix guard used strlen > 2 and missed the exactly-two-byte case (fix.diff:23)
both shapes split across several data events, plus the same end-chunk trailer completed by a later event (must then emit end/close, fix.diff:48-57)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second, transport-specific chunked decoder for the client (e.g. used for proxied or tunnelled responses) that does its own chunk framing instead of reusing ChunkedDecoder.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The client already branches on response framing headers here, and react/http supports several connectors (proxy, SOCKS, SSH) through this same request stream, so a maintainer could plausibly have written a separate decoder for one transport.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Decoding the chunked body when a user constructs a ServerRequest from a raw ReadableStreamInterface, rather than trusting the caller to have de-chunked it.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This constructor already inspects Transfer-Encoding to decide the body size, so adding a decoder for the streaming body there is a small, plausible maintainer change.

O9_family: CWE-835: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop') — algorithmic-complexity denial of service in a stream parser

O10_build.toolchain: Composer (composer.json, no composer.lock, vendor/ not checked in) and PHPUnit 4.8/5.7/9.6; phpunit.xml.dist for PHPUnit 9.6+, phpunit.xml.legacy for older; CI matrix PHP 5.3-8.4
O10_build.project_tests: tests/Io/ChunkedDecoderTest.php (44 test methods, including split-chunk and trailer cases), plus tests/Io/RequestHeaderParserTest.php and tests/Io/ClientRequestStreamTest.php for the two call sites

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add only the end-chunk 'no CRLF yet' return (or make any missing CRLF an error), which leaves the exactly-two-byte non-CRLF case spinning forever or breaks chunk bodies and trailers that arrive split across data events.

out_of_scope_notes: src/Io/MultipartParser.php:125-149 has its own buffer loop for multipart bodies, outside this advisory's chunked-encoding property; not examined further.
